summary: Alamo Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Bank of America, as administrative agent, on May 27, 2026. The agreement provides up to $602.5 million in facilities, consisting of a $202.5 million term loan and a $400 million revolving credit line with a five-year term ending May 27, 2031. Borrowings bear interest at a variable rate based on the Company's consolidated net leverage ratio, with margins ranging from 1.25%-2.25% for Term SOFR and 0.25%-1.25% for base rate. The agreement includes financial maintenance covenants, limitations on debt and investments, and customary representations. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit facilities, not a special situation.
